mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: the current temperature is 61 degrees under overcast skies near the Verona Area High School, and the moon is in a waxing gibbous phase.

The City of Verona is excited to announce the I Voted sticker contest for K through 12 students. Submissions are open until July 22, and the community will vote on the winning designs between July 28 and August 7 to determine what voters will receive this November. Also, residents are reminded to check their mailboxes for winter readiness and review the official damage policy on the city website if you have concerns about plow maintenance.

We have a packed schedule starting with live music today at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Dane County Farmers' Market at the State Capitol or live music at Paddy Mac's.
In our weekly police report, on July 13, a driver was taken into custody for an O-W-I after officers responded to a report of a vehicle stuck on a large rock.
The delicious flavor of the day is Chocolate Volcano. The store is currently closed but will open at 10 AM, so get ready to head over then.
